definition: in an early period of life
description: An outdoor basketball court on a bright summer day. A young man with curly hair in a grey vest laughs as he bounces the ball, watched by a semicircle of onlookers. A man in a business suit leaps and lays the ball into the hoop. The young man then passes the ball to a white-haired elderly woman holding shopping bags, who shoots; everyone looks up as the ball drops through the net, and a courier in a yellow jacket rides up on a bike to take his turn while the crowd claps.

taps.phrase: to carry a brown paper bag
